text:
people-ops: Quick heads-up — candidate Sarah M. needs to move from 11:00am panel to 2:00pm today due to travel. Can someone cover the 2:00pm slot (ENG-IC-3)? Also two quick debrief/rubric things below.

anya: I can take 2pm. please add me to the calendar event.

mike: I can cover 11am. thanks for the ping.

jordan: Thanks — confirmed. small rubric note: are we normalizing scores across panels today? last week numbers were a bit off.

liz_recruiter: Link to current rubric + anchors: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/example-rubric. People-ops, can you drop the debrief form link and AV room details so new panelists have everything?

people-ops: Added Anya to 2pm and Mike to 11am on the invite. Debrief form here: https://forms.company.com/debrief/eng-interviews. AV/room note: Room B (2nd floor) — log in with team account, HDMI + AirPlay available. room-bot: Room B reserved until 16:00.

mike: Thanks — one more ask: scoring anchors? quick paste would help.

people-ops: Pasting the anchors we use (short):
```text
5 - Exceptional: concrete examples of impact, leadership, deep ownership
4 - Strong: consistently meets/above, few gaps
3 - Meets expectations: solid + some growth areas
2 - Needs improvement: noticeable gaps in core areas
1 - Major gaps: cannot perform role without retraining
```

anya: Got it — I'll include those when debriefing. Also adding a quick confidence score field (1-5) on the form helps us later.

jordan: Yes — small policy: if candidate has 3+ independent reviewers we run light normalization (z-score) before finalizing. If <3, we use raw anchored scores + written rationale. People-ops, can you flag when a candidate hits 3+?

people-ops: Will do. We'll flag and run the normalization where applicable. Quick operational ask: new panelists please fill the short pre-panel checklist in the invite (camera, audio, notes template).

liz_recruiter: I'll message Sarah about the time change and update calendar. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

mike: all set 11am here. see you.

anya: on it for 2pm — thanks.

people-ops: Closing loop — calendar updated, debrief form + rubric posted, room reserved. Ping here for any last-minute swaps.
